primary_gt.answer: cold-persistence-dominated with co-timed snow and wind stress
primary_gt.decision_rule: Use the cold-persistence label because FDD exceeds 10 C-day, the subzero Tmin run lasts 3 days, 60 hours are subzero, and all mean precipitation checks stay below 4 mm.

formulas.fdd_c_day: sum(max(0, 0 - daily_Tmin_C)) over the event window
formulas.snow_share_on_below0_tmin_days: snowfall on days with daily_Tmin_C < 0 divided by event snowfall total
formulas.below0_snow_hours: count of hourly records with temperature_2m < 0 C and snowfall > 0 cm

criteria.name: Dominance label and format
criteria.description: Returns compact short-answer JSON and labels the event cold-persistence dominated with co-timed snow and wind stress.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for the correct cold-persistence label with incomplete JSON, or up to 2 points for a well-formed JSON object whose label omits the co-timed snow and wind stress. Give no credit for a precipitation-dominated or non-analytic answer.

criteria.name: Cold-load metrics
criteria.description: Reports 7 window days, 11.8 C-day FDD, 3 below-zero daily minima, a 3-day run, and 60 below-zero hours.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point each for the event-window length, FDD, below-zero daily-minimum count, longest run, and below-zero hourly count when values are within tolerance. Deduct the relevant point for wrong formulas, wrong thresholds, or missing units.

criteria.name: Peak cold and wind timing
criteria.description: Reports -6.3 C on 2016-01-24, 92.2 km/h at 2016-01-24T00:00, and -4.9 C at that hour.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the coldest daily minimum and date, 1 point for the maximum gust and timestamp, and 1 point for the temperature at the gust hour. Minor rounding errors within tolerance keep credit.

criteria.name: Snow overlap metrics
criteria.description: Reports 9.87 cm total snow, 4.62 cm maximum day on 2016-01-24, 61 snow hours, 38 below-zero snow hours, and 0.865 snow share.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1 point for total and maximum daily snowfall, up to 1 point for snow-hour and below-zero snow-hour counts, and up to 1 point for the below-zero Tmin-day snow share. Do not award share credit if the denominator is not event-total snowfall.

criteria.name: Precipitation mean check
criteria.description: Uses ERA5 1.32 mm, GPM 0.03 mm, and CHIRPS 3.75 mm as checks against a precipitation-dominated reading.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct gridded precipitation mean within tolerance. If one value is misread but the answer still treats the means as modest, only the affected value loses credit.

criteria.name: Numerical interpretation
criteria.description: Explains the threshold and timing logic without adding external loss claims or broad causal speculation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for linking the FDD, subzero run, and subzero hours to persistence, and 1 point for using snow, gust, and precipitation timing to reject a precipitation-dominated reading. Deduct for external impact claims or uncomputed management claims.
